ailment.angin_gelombang.desc: Dizziness like drifting on waves; a cool body and a slow pulse.
ailment.angin_gelombang.name: Wave Wind
ailment.batuk_debu.desc: A dry cough as if choked by dust; red eyes and a slow pulse.
ailment.batuk_debu.name: Dust Cough
ailment.demam_embun.desc: Shivering at dawn; a warm forehead and a quick pulse.
ailment.demam_embun.name: Dew Fever
ailment.kepala_kabut.desc: A foggy head with droopy eyes and a weak pulse.
ailment.kepala_kabut.name: Misty Head
ailment.kulit_getah.desc: An itchy rash as if touched by sap; yellow tongue, quick pulse.
ailment.kulit_getah.name: Sap Skin
ailment.kulit_lembap.desc: A damp rash and bloating; a sweaty forehead and a wavy pulse.
ailment.kulit_lembap.name: Damp Skin
ailment.lambung_panas.desc: A tender, hot belly with a yellow tongue and a strong pulse.
ailment.lambung_panas.name: Hot Stomach
ailment.mata_pasir.desc: Stinging eyes as if full of sand; red tongue, wavy pulse.
ailment.mata_pasir.name: Sandy Eyes
ailment.otot_tegang.desc: Tight, warm muscles with a red tongue and a strong pulse.
ailment.otot_tegang.name: Tense Muscles
ailment.perut_kabut.desc: A bloated, sluggish belly with a white tongue and a weak pulse.
ailment.perut_kabut.name: Misty Belly
ailment.sendi_karat.desc: Stiff joints as if rusted; a cool body and a slow pulse.
ailment.sendi_karat.name: Rusty Joints
ailment.tenggorok_kering.desc: A dry, itchy throat with a red tongue and a strong pulse.
ailment.tenggorok_kering.name: Dry Throat

clinic.exam_done: Examination of {name} finished (placeholder, no diagnosis yet).
clinic.exam_empty: No patient in the exam room.
clinic.patient_left_waiting: {name} went home after waiting too long.
clinic.room_occupied: The exam room is still occupied.
complaint.batuk_kering: My throat itches and I keep coughing.
complaint.demam_dingin: My body has been hot and cold since last night and my head feels heavy.
complaint.gatal_kulit: The skin on my arms is itchy and red.
complaint.lelah_berat: I tire easily and cannot sleep soundly.
complaint.mata_perih: My eyes have been stinging and watering since yesterday.
complaint.perut_kembung: My stomach feels bloated and uneasy after meals.
complaint.pusing_berputar: My head spins every time I stand up.
complaint.sendi_kaku: My knees and wrists are stiff in the morning.
craft.measure_help: Hold POUR to fill, release right at the gold line.
craft.pick_help: Tap herbs on the shelf to take them in recipe order.
craft.pound_help: Tap when the shrinking ring meets the gold circle. Follow the rhythm.
craft.stir_help: Circle your finger around the bowl at a steady speed inside the green band.
diag.no_energy: No exam energy left. Make your diagnosis.
diag.pulse_help: Feel the pulse: tap along with its rhythm, then keep it going when the cues vanish.
diag.pulse_unclear: The pulse was unclear. Try again if you have energy.
diag.verdict_help: Compare your findings with each possibility. Green = matches, red = contradicts.
dlg.dewi.about: I love playing near the pond. The water is clear and cool.
dlg.dewi.about2: Mother says healers know all the medicinal leaves. Is that true?
dlg.joko.about: The pond in the north-east has plump fish. Mornings are best.
dlg.joko.about2: At noon I fetch water at the well, then go back to fishing.
dlg.joko.greet: Shh, not so loud, you'll scare the fish.
dlg.karto.about: I planted those leaves myself. The garden is open to you any time.
dlg.karto.about2: Morning is the best time to tend plants. At midday I rest in the square.
dlg.karto.greet: Welcome, Healer. The herb garden is thriving.
dlg.lastri.about: I go to the well early, then help out in the herb garden.
dlg.lastri.about2: The children play at the pond. I always worry when they lose track of time.
dlg.lastri.greet: Welcome, Healer. Where have you been?
dlg.no_request: Nothing for now. Thanks for asking, Healer.
dlg.patient.called: Called already? Alright, I'm heading to the exam room.
dlg.patient.coming: I'm on my way to the clinic. {complaint}
dlg.patient.leaving: Thank you, Healer. I'm going home now.
dlg.raka.about: I help Father in the garden and sometimes roam the village for news.
dlg.raka.about2: In the evening I like going to the pond. The view is lovely.
dlg.raka.greet: Oh, Healer! Need help carrying anything?
dlg.ratih.about: Each morning I pick spices in the garden, then deliver them to the clinic before noon.
dlg.ratih.about2: The queue is usually busy in the afternoon. Be sure to open the clinic on time.
dlg.ratih.greet: Why, Healer. My spices are fresh today.
dlg.request_accepted: Thank you, Healer. I'll be waiting for your news.
dlg.request_claim: All done? Thank you so much, Healer!
dlg.request_declined: That's fine. Let me know if you find the time.
dlg.request_done: Thanks for helping, Healer. The village is lucky to have you.
dlg.request_pending: How about my request? Not done yet?
dlg.sari.about: I sell along the village road in the morning, then move to the square before noon.
dlg.sari.about2: Many villagers have started complaining of aches. Your clinic may get busy.
dlg.sari.greet: Healer! What luck, do stop by.
dlg.wiryo.about: This village was here long before I was born. That clinic used to be a small hut.
dlg.wiryo.about2: If you are unsure, ask the villagers how they are. Everyone has a story.
dlg.wiryo.greet: Ah, young healer. Sit a while, child.
method.akupunktur.desc: Needle the right points. Needs a careful aim.

recipe.bilasan_mata_segar.desc: Betel leaf, andrographis and aromatic ginger.
recipe.bilasan_mata_segar.name: Fresh Eye Rinse
recipe.jamu_pelega_napas.desc: Betel leaf, aromatic ginger and cinnamon.
recipe.jamu_pelega_napas.name: Breath-Ease Tonic
recipe.lulur_pelentur_sendi.name: Joint-Loosening Rub
recipe.ramuan_penghangat.desc: Turmeric, ginger and lemongrass, pounded then stirred.

recipe.seduhan_penyejuk.desc: Javanese turmeric, andrographis and cat's whiskers.

req_kabar_joko.offer: Please ask how Mr. Joko is doing at the pond. They say the fish are plentiful today.
req_kabar_joko.remind: Did you meet Mr. Joko? Did he catch many fish?
req_kabar_joko.title: Ask after Mr. Joko
req_lihat_kebun.offer: Could you check on the herb garden? I want to know if the plants are healthy.
req_lihat_kebun.remind: Have you seen the herb garden? How are the plants?
req_lihat_kebun.title: Check on the herb garden
req_lihat_resepsi.offer: Could you look at the clinic waiting area? I'd like to know if the benches are comfortable enough.
req_lihat_resepsi.remind: Did you see the waiting area? What do you think?
req_lihat_resepsi.title: Look at the clinic waiting area
req_salam_wiryo.offer: Please pass my greetings to Grandpa Wiryo. I haven't had time to visit him in ages.
req_salam_wiryo.remind: Did you meet Grandpa Wiryo? How is he?
req_salam_wiryo.title: Pass greetings to Grandpa Wiryo
